Package org.ether.society.engines.tier2

package org.ether.society.engines.tier2

Tier 2: Pluggable Cliodynamic, Sociological & Macroeconomic Hypotheses

Provides interfaces, registries, and abstractions for competing socio-historical and macroeconomic theories. These engines can be independently enabled, disabled, modulated, or calibrated against empirical historical records.
